measurement_limits: Three real browsers supplement 180 protocol clients; this is not 180-browser acceptance.
Input event to next animation-frame callback is a proxy, not observed physical paint.
Action/request spans use the probe process clock; runtime spans use each page's Performance clock.
Join request and server evidence by IDs; do not subtract unanchored clocks or sum overlapping stages.
Failed actions retain their full timeout durations. Absent later actions are unobserved, not zero.
